entities.summary: Daniel Fernholm is a Swedish former professional ice hockey defenseman. He last played for Djurgårdens IF of the Swedish Hockey League (SHL). Fernholm was selected by the Pittsburgh Penguins in the 4th round of the 2002 NHL Entry Draft.
